messages:
Elena: Heads up — BrightSky flagged a ~3M token spike in their nightly usage report for 2026-06-18 (noticed in our billing run). They asked for a credit. Our cursory correlation looks like a gateway deploy that altered SDK batching behavior around 02:47 UTC. Can we triage?

Samir: On it. Which invoice and any sample request ids?

Elena: Invoice INV-2026-06-BS-7789. Sample request ids: r_c1a7f9..., r_c1a8ab... Quick metering query we ran shows the day totals: 

```
select customer, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(request_id) as reqs
from metering.events
where customer='brightsky' and day='2026-06-18'
group by customer;
-- tokens: 3,012,143; reqs: 28,945
```

Priya: I pushed the gateway change at 2026-06-18T02:47Z (commit abc123). We tuned the HTTP client to use a 5s batch flush (was 50ms). That can make many small interactions coalesce and if retries trigger we might resend whole batches. I'll grep the gateway logs.

Tomas: CS saw duplicate chat messages in the customer's app logs between ~02:50 and 03:20 UTC. They can share snippets.

Marta: billing-bot also flagged this as a likely duplication spike. Estimated incremental bill impact is ~$2,200 for that day. Requesting pre-approval for a one-off credit while engineering investigates. @Samir can finance pre-approve up to $2k pending evidence? :thinking_face:

Samir: I can pre-approve up to $2,000 once we have linked request_ids and confirmation that duplicates were actually billed. Anything above that requires CGO sign-off. We need a short doc: timeline, evidence (request_id hits), and linked invoice. I'll open a Zendesk credit hold: ZD-12984.

Elena: Filed ZD-12984 and attached the metering dump + gateway deploy log. Also ran a duplicate-check query: 

```
select request_id, count(*) as hits
from metering.events
where customer='brightsky' and ts between '2026-06-18T02:45:00Z' and '2026-06-18T03:30:00Z'
group by request_id
having hits > 1
order by hits desc
limit 50;
```

Priya: I'll correlate those request_ids with gateway traces and client retry headers (x-retry-count). If we see batch replays (same batch id, multiple deliveries) that's conclusive. ETA ~6h for initial correlation.

Samir: Action items: Priya to confirm dedupe evidence (ETA 6h). Elena/Marta to gather formal credit request + invoice id (done). I've marked pre-approval for $2k in the ticket. @Tomas please notify the customer that we're investigating and will likely auto-credit up to $2k.

Tomas: On it — I'll message them now with an apology and ETA, and note ZD-12984.

billing-bot: Automated: Credit hold placed on INV-2026-06-BS-7789, status=PENDING, ticket=ZD-12984.

Marta: If final confirmed amount >$2k, escalate to finance-leads for exception approval. Also recommend we add a metering guard/alert for batch-replay anomalies (Priya, could you take on a proposal?).

Priya: Agree — I'll file an ops ticket with a suggested alert: trigger when customer tokens/hour > 1.5x baseline 24h median and duplicate request_id fraction > 0.1. Will include proposed query and runbook.

Samir: Good plan. Please post the findings and the final credit calc in ZD-12984. Pre-approval stands at $2k pending Priya's confirmation. Closing this thread for now — will update when we have correlation results. :thumbsup:
